thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU queue for cluster 'inference-prod' > 750 (sustained 12m). Pending pods: 23. Autoscaler failed to create nodegroup 'gpu-ng-2' due to IAM/instance-profile error. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/alert/2291234567

maria: acked and paging oncall. @sam can you take? :eyes:

sam: oncall here — ack. grabbing context. what's the user impact?

maria: observed ~30% throughput drop on /v1/generate, spike in 429s and p95 latency. backlog in inference queue_service ~720->780. Cluster-autoscaler logs show create failure with AccessDenied/iam:PassRole.

raj: pulled CA logs. snippet:
```
cluster-autoscaler: scaleUp: trying to scale up group gpu-ng-2
cluster-autoscaler: Error creating AutoScalingGroup: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole
\tat com.amazonaws...
```

sam: ok. can someone paste `kubectl get pods` / `kubectl describe pod` for a pending inference pod?

maria: pending pod reasons include `0/0 nodes available: 23 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, node(s) didn't match nodeSelector, or node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate`. Node taint: `nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule` on new GPU nodes.

julia: ops-check — we rolled infra-perms change 2 days ago (PR #4519) that adjusted the instance profile mapping. suspect regression: when CA tried to create LT it picked up an older launch-template version lacking instanceProfile ARN.

sam: mitigation options: 1) manual ASG scale up to force nodes; 2) update ASG to use LT version with proper instanceProfile; 3) temporarily relax taints/schedule low-priority jobs. Julia, can you do manual ASG bump? I'll coordinate customer comms.

julia: doing manual bump now: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-ng-2 --desired-capacity 5 --honor-cooldown`

ops-bot: deploybot: starting infra rollback job referenced by @julia (PR #4521).

maria: pods are starting to schedule on the newly created nodes, queue draining visible. still seeing elevated 429s but trending down.

raj: more root cause detail: CA attempted to use LaunchTemplate v7 which contains correct `InstanceProfile: arn:aws:iam::111111111:instance-profile/RedwoodGPURole`, but ASG was still pinned to LT v3 which lacks the mapping. CA cannot create ASG with v7 because iam:PassRole is blocked for the CA service principal in the current policy set. Two independent failures combined.

sam: copy. Julia — can you update ASG to LT v7 so nodes spin up with the right profile? Command example: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-ng-2 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd1234,Version=7`

julia: running that now.

maria: customer impact note draft: "Between 08:22-08:47 PT we experienced capacity shortage in inference-prod causing some requests to be throttled (429) and increased latency for a subset of customers. Root cause: autoscaler failed to provision GPU nodes because of an IAM PassRole denial combined with ASG->LT version mismatch. Remediation performed: manual ASG update to correct LT version and a temporary desired-capacity increase. New nodes successfully joined and backlog drained. No data exposure."

sam: thanks. I've opened the incident in PagerDuty and marked for postmortem. tagging infra oncall. @julia please continue rollback/patch.

julia: update-auto-scaling-group returned success. new instances provisioning, then `kubectl get nodes` shows 3 extra nodes with label `gpu=true` and taint `nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule` — pods scheduling now.

ops-bot: monitor: queue length reduced from 780 -> 180 in ~9m. error rate for /v1/generate back to baseline.

maria: confirming metrics: 5 customers saw elevated 429s, blended error rate +3.4% during window. I'll file customer comms follow-up.

sam: action items for follow-up:
- infra: patch IAM policy to ensure CA can pass the instance profile or add a preflight check (owner: julia)
- runtime: add an integration test validating CA can create a nodegroup with current LT (owner: raj)
- deploy: add LT/ASG version consistency check to deploy pipeline (owner: eng-release)
- runbook: update autoscaler troubleshooting steps and include quick manual ASG commands (owner: maria)

julia: will open PR to adjust role mapping + a rollback playbook. PR #4530.

sam: do we want to keep ASG at increased capacity or scale back?

maria: scaling back to target 2 and leaving a small buffer of 1 reserved node. I'll run `set-desired-capacity` to 3 in 15m if metrics stable.

julia: nodes are healthy and join certificates validated.

maria: queue at 45 and decreasing. p95 latency returning to normal. starting incident timeline doc in docs/incidents/2291234567.md

sam: closing pager in 10. final checks?

maria: no open blockers. issuing customer follow-up and scheduling RCA.

sam: resolved. great cross-team work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident status -> RESOLVED. summary saved to https://incidents.redwood/2291234567

maria: follow-up checklist assigned; will own the postmortem.

julia: will update IAM and deploy test.

sam: thanks everyone.
